coordinates.object_orientation: +Z shell growth axis, narrow rounded base Z0, broad low capped end Z0.045m. CenterXY, front -Y, side +X, top +Z.

concept.reason: Actual same-species fossil photo and species-specific lid description adequate; no generated concept needed.

taxon: Radiolites dario (Catullo), printed darìo by Cestari2005
primary_specimen: Cestari2005 Plate2 Fig1 right-hand individual, La Sapienza University collection; individual catalog number not given
scope: Same-species interpretation: lower valve based on the smaller right-hand R.dario specimen in Plate2 Fig1; low flat lid reconstructed from the same paper species description. The photographed specimen does not establish preserved upper valve. No other rudist species combined.

scale.basis: Caption gives base width7cm for the whole Fig1 panel. Smaller right specimen about43-45mm tall and25-28mm wide based on panel scaling. Depth is an inference, not measured; use45x25x23mm working dimensions including thin restored lid.
scale.uncertainty: Partial fossil and oblique photo: rounded estimates, not exact specimen measurement or scan. No claim of missing basal length.

required_features: Conical flaring right valve: narrower rounded/truncated base broadens toward wide upper rim; slight asymmetric curve, not parallel tube.
Pronounced longitudinal ribbing crossed by stepped, layered outer growth lamellae. Read as a robust shell rather than smooth cup or spiral shell.
Low flat operculiform upper valve, fitting broad end with subtle valve seam, is same-species textual reconstruction. No tall dome, spikes or invented apertures.
One isolated individual only, omit adjacent larger specimen, substrate and broken adherent chips.
Use broad shell fluting and a few strong stepped growth episodes; do not reproduce every surface fracture.
simplifications: Upper valve not confirmed preserved in photograph; restored shape supported only by same-species published description.
Hidden inner shell cells, ligament/hinge and microscopic structure omitted; no unsupported open interior.
Neutral muted stone palette artistic; no original life-color claim and no paper image as texture.
acceptance_focus: Front/side silhouette visibly widens from base to rim; approximately45x25x23mm, low cap not hemisphere.
Ribs and layered lamellae legible in fourviews without detached collar rings or floating parts.
Single shell; no borrowed R.nouleti or R.squamosus proportions.
maker_notes: Read private/research.md and view private/plate2.png; ONLY Fig1 right-hand specimen, NOT Fig5 Distefanella.
Same localdir to independent QA, READY then FINAL. No maker upload or deletion. Root handles async backup and grouped integration.
Only four standard final views, cheap shape checks first; no concept generation. User asleep, internal candidate only.
